systemIcons.description: Use the shell's icon for each file type.

customFolderIcons.description: Let a folder show the icon it carries.

writeDirectoryIndex.description: Keep a hidden .yafm-index.db inside every folder that is browsed.

directoryIndexBlacklist.description: Glob rules for folders that keep their index in the central store.

extensionIcons.description: Built-in icon name or file:<path> for one extension.

quickAccess.description: Quick access folders, in order; empty keeps the well-known defaults.

recentLimit.description: How many recent folders to show; 0 turns the list off.

galleryRoots.description: Folders the gallery scans; empty uses the Pictures folder.

overviewPanels.description: Overview panels, in the order they are shown.

overviewHidden.description: Panels older versions hid; only read to migrate them away.

placeNames.description: Name given to a quick-access folder, by path.

shortcuts.description: Key combination per action, e.g. ctrl+w.

placeIcons.description: Icon given to a quick-access folder, by path.

overviewTitles.description: Title given to an overview panel, by panel id.

overviewViews.description: List or grid per overview panel, by panel id.

overviewIcons.description: Icon per overview panel, by panel id.

overviewPinned.description: Overview panels that also appear in the sidebar.

linksEnabled.description: Open yafm:// links with this app.

panelPlaces.description: Folders shown by one quick-access panel, by panel id.

restoreTabs.description: Reopen the tabs that were open when the app closed.

openTabs.description: Tabs open at the last close; the window keeps these up to date.

activeTab.description: Index of the tab that was focused.

defaultView.description: View mode, sizes and preview strip every folder starts with.

showCheckboxes.description: Show a selection checkbox before every name.

openOnSingleClick.description: Open a folder or file with one click instead of two.

confirmDelete.description: Ask before moving items to the recycle bin.

trayAutoShow.description: Show the floating file tray when a drag starts.

accentColor.description: Colour the whole interface is built around.

secondaryColor.description: Second colour of the accent gradient.

language.description: Interface language; 'system' follows the operating system.

defaultFileManager.description: Register this app for folder opens.

backgroundSource.description: Backdrop picture, video or built-in concept; empty keeps the dark surface.

protectedPaths.description: Paths a change must stop at; a trailing ** covers the subtree.

deleteDelaySeconds.description: Seconds the protected-folder confirmation stays disabled.

timeFormatPattern.description: Pattern used when timeFormat is custom.

archiveHandler.description: Register this app for archive files.

pickerWindowWidth.description: Width of the folder and file picker window.

pickerWindowHeight.description: Height of the folder and file picker window.

linkPathMode.description: Links are created relative unless this is 'absolute'.

overviewBanner.description: Picture or video above the overview panels.

overviewBannerOffset.description: Vertical crop of the banner, 0 is the top.

globalHotkey.description: Key combination that brings the window forward; empty disables it.

fonts.description: Font family per interface role; empty uses the built-in faces.

sharePortMode.description: 'random' lets the OS pick a free port; 'custom' uses sharePort.

sharePort.description: Port used when sharePortMode is custom.

startupMode.description: 'none', 'shortcut' or 'task': how the app joins the session.

startHidden.description: Start in the tray instead of showing the window.

favorites.description: Files and folders pinned to the overview Favorites panel.

themeMode.description: Interface theme; 'system' follows the operating system, otherwise 'light' or 'dark'.
